metadata.description: Claude Code mods by ezoushen — plugins whose behavior lives in hooks modules.

plugins.name: mermaid-pane
plugins.description: Renders mermaid code blocks inline as ASCII art (beautiful-mermaid, termaid) or images with an open-full-size button; mermaid.ink is opt-in via /mermaid external on.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Render image paths inline: a thumbnail in the user's prompt row (aspect-fill, max 10 rows) and in agent reply rows when the model mentions a path. Recognises a real file path ending in a supported image extension, or an [Image #N] token stored by the /image command.
